title: Company Structural Record
description: Structural identity anchor for a company. Legal name, jurisdiction, ticker, website, headquarters, and all sourced attributes belong exclusively in Facts.

id.description: Stable UUID used as the Company graph node and Fact relationship target.

schema_version.description: Version of this structural Company contract.

entity_type.description: Fixed collection discriminator used for deterministic typed references.

slug.description: Stable repository key; it is not an evidentiary company name.

display_name.description: Non-authoritative interface label for navigation; never the canonical legal name.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this structural graph node was created.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted repository-administration update.

record_status.description: Repository-management state, not the company's operating status.

administrative_notes.description: Optional repository-management note containing no asserted business facts.
